items.name: arm_notification

docs.body:
Interpret the latest revisioned text-load request cell entirely in Fe.

 A zero-payload actor notification wakes this task after the resident
 transition writes a new cell value. The notification is kept live beside
 fetch and body operations with heterogeneous `Select`, so a newer revision
 cancels stale browser work without JavaScript learning the request shape.
 Browser strings are copied into owned bounded UTF-8 memory before a second
 suspension, and every acquired `Response` is released explicitly.
